what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Belgium, as recorded by IDMC.
In 2024, the latest year with a figure, IDMC recorded 49 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Belgium list floods and storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Belgium.

when.text: IDMC records new displacements by disasters year by year, starting in 2018.
The main year of displacement in the data is 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went inside Belgium.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
